usedFor: Timesheet holds projects and rates, and Google Docs records each “New Project” through “Add or Replace Text In Tab”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Project” in Timesheet, then “Add or Replace Text In Tab” in Google Docs
bestTemplate.why: Each new project is written into a doc tab, so the team has one written brief.

watchOut: “New Project” is polling and the action can replace a tab, so check both before relying on it.
